item.text: [{"task_id":"4e469f39","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['config'][0]))","    wall = int(round(params['config'][1]))","    ink = int(round(params['config'][2]))","    step = int(round(params['config'][3]))","    rightward = int(round(params['config'][4]))","    leftward = int(round(params['config'][5]))","    neighbors = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['neighbors']]","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    seen = set()","    for point in np.argwhere(grid == wall).tolist():","        seed = (point[0], point[1])","        if seed in seen:","            continue","        seen.add(seed)","        component = [seed]","        queue = [seed]","        while queue:","            r, c = queue.pop()","            for dr, dc in neighbors:","                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","                if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width and (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr, nc] == wall:","                    seen.add((nr, nc))","                    queue.append((nr, nc))","                    component.append((nr, nc))","        top = min(p[0] for p in component)","        bottom = max(p[0] for p in component)","        left = min(p[1] for p in component)","        right = max(p[1] for p in component)","        gaps = [c for c in range(left + step, right) if grid[top, c] == bg]","        if not gaps:","            continue","        gap = gaps[0]","        direction = rightward if gap -
